title: A bare research twin's facts are matched to the kb agent's by one url form, so a twin citing the rendered page of a raw source matches nothing
goal: score_twins matches a twin's cited url to a kb DOC fact's source url after normalising the forms one source takes (raw.githubusercontent.com against its rendered docs page, http against https, a trailing slash or fragment), so facts_matched counts what the twin's notes cite; the review of SP-3pvz2noj found 0 of 89 matched in r1-02 although the notes cite pip.pypa.io pages

run:
import inspect, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bench_multi
s = inspect.getsource(bench_multi.score_twins) + inspect.getsource(bench_multi)
assert 'normalize_url' in s or 'url_key' in s, 'a twin fact is matched by its exact url form only'
